title: Encouraging Prospective Tertiary Students to Pursue Careers in Special Needs Education
what_it_is: Encouraging Prospective Tertiary Students to Pursue Careers in Special Needs Education

sections.label: Special needs education recruitment and training
sections.summary: MOE outlines recruitment efforts, the Journeys of Excellence Package, enhanced Diploma in Special Education, and increased funding for SPED schools from 2024 to 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education given the growing demand for special needs education, whether the Ministry will be considering initiatives to encourage and train more prospective tertiary students to pursue careers in special needs education and rehabilitation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There are ongoing recruitment efforts to attract university graduates and diploma holders from diverse backgrounds with the relevant skills, competencies and dispositions, including efforts in partnering Institutes of Higher Learning.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Beyond recruitment, MOE is also committed to strengthening the SPED sector as a system.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: First, we launched the Journeys of Excellence Package in 2020, to strengthen the professionalism of SPED teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In 2022, we enhanced the Diploma in Special Education (DISE) to better equip SPED teachers with the necessary skills and competencies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Participation in DISE is a requirement for all SPED teachers and is sponsored by MOE.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will increase funding to SPED schools between 2024 and 2026 to raise the average salaries for teachers and teacher aides to maintain market competitiveness and strengthen the professionalism of the SPED sector.

sections.label: Encouraging SPED sector participation
sections.summary: MOE welcomes the suggestion and will work with social service agencies to encourage more people, including through conversion, to join SPED training.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We know this SPED sector is a very challenging sector to be in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: So, we welcome Mr Yip's suggestion and we will look into various ways and work with the social service agencies who are operating the SPED schools, to encourage a lot more people, even through conversion, if there are interested individuals to do so and they are keen to participate in the training programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: As mentioned earlier, we have developed a framework for them to go through professional development, including the starting course, which is a Diploma in Special Education.
